outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production VFX texture for an original 2D samurai dark-fantasy action RPG. Generate ONE straight horizontal sword-energy brush ribbon on a genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background, no scene. This will be UV-warped into a moving slash arc by Godot. Layout: wide landscape canvas; a single left-to-right ribbon centered vertically, tapered to hairline tips at both horizontal ends; maximum ribbon thickness about 22% of canvas height, length about 82% of canvas width; generous clear transparent margins on all four edges. Direction travels from left to right. Visually rich hand-drawn cel-animated action-game effect: strong irregular ivory-white leading blade strand, pale ice-cyan rim and turquoise broken secondary strands, very restrained warm gold on the inner edge (at most 10%). Dense solid white central blade shapes, highly designed torn brush tips, graphic ink-like negative cuts THROUGH the ribbon, 5 to 7 sharp nested material tones. Dynamic asymmetric brushwork, broad bulge near the right-hand third and long trailing wisps to the left. Tiny crystal chips allowed only hugging the ribbon. A fierce slash silhouette rather than a uniform beam. Crisp hard painted edges, no glow clouds, no blur, no soft airbrushing, no smooth vector outlines, no round-ended laser, no gradients fading to black, no background, no checkerboard, no letters, no characters, no weapons, no UI. High fidelity original illustrated VFX with the dramatic clarity and hand-drawn energy of premium isometric action games. Ally colors white and cyan; no purple or magenta. One isolated usable straight texture, NOT a curved crescent, NOT an animation sheet.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite texture for a sharp samurai sword HIT impact in an original 2D dark-fantasy action game. One isolated impact burst centered on a square canvas with generous transparent margins, all artwork inside the central 70% of the canvas. Genuinely transparent alpha background. A powerful asymmetrical hand-drawn white-ivory flash cut diagonally from lower left to upper right, enclosed by 6 to 9 large irregular ice-cyan and deep turquoise torn blade petals and crystalline shards. Dense white core occupies roughly one fifth of the burst; bold hard cel-painted edges, sharp ink-like negative-space cracks, several long thin directional streaks, deliberate graphic shape design. Original premium hand-animated action RPG VFX, readable at 96 pixels across; do not render an explosion cloud or a flower. Color hierarchy: brilliant ivory white core, pale cyan cutting surfaces, turquoise facets, darkest blue only in small edge facets, optional extremely restrained pale gold glints. No purple, no magenta, no red. No smooth vector starburst, no photoreal particles, no soft radial glow or airbrush blur, no black background, no checkerboard, no letters or text, no scenery, no character, no sword object, no interface, no frame, no contact shadow. Single angular brush-painted impact sprite, not an animation sheet.
